resources.string: Connect this phone to a computer you trust.
See your phone\'s notifications on your computer.
Make and answer phone calls from your computer.
Browse recent photos and screenshots on your computer.
Send files between your phone and your computer.
Copy on one device and paste on the other.
Show your phone\'s screen on your computer and use its apps there.
See your phone\'s battery, signal and sound mode on your computer.
Make this phone ring from your computer when you cannot find it.
Once it is ready, this feature stays off until you turn it on here. link2linux asks for the Android permissions it needs at that moment, not before.
